body.text:
Vaj 1; folio 26r1-v4 (Cz 27.1-1)
namo śākyamunaye tathāgatāyārhate samyaksaṃbuddhāya / //
body.translated_text: [Vaj 1] Homage to <s>Śākyamuni</s>, the <s>Tathāgata</s>, the <s>Arhat</s>, the Perfectly Enlightened One.

body.text: evaṃ mayā śrutam ekasmin samaye bhagavān / śrāvastyāṃ viharati sma / jetavane / anāthapiṇḍadasyārāme mahatā bhikṣusaṃghena sārdham ardhatrayodaśabhir bhikṣuśataiḥ

children.text: atha khalu bhagavān pūrvāhṇakālasamaye nivāsya pātracīvaram ādāya / śrāvastīṃ mahānagarīṃ piṇḍāya prāviśat / atha khalu bhagavān / śrāvastīṃ mahānagarī
children.translated_text: Then the <s>Bhagavān</s>, in the forenoon, having dressed and taken his bowl and robe, entered the great city of <s>Śrāvastī</s> for alms. Then the <s>Bhagavān</s>, [having entered] the great city of <s>Śrāvastī</s>

children.text: piṇḍāya caritvā paścādbhaktapiṇḍapātapratikrāntaḥ pādau prakṣālya nyaṣīdad bhagavān / prajñapta evāsane paryaṃkam ābhujya ṛjuṃ kāyaṃ praṇidhāya pratimukhaṃ smṛtim upasthāpya / atha saṃbahulā bhikṣavaḥ yena bhagavāṃs tenopasaṃkkraman upasaṃkkramya bhagavataḥ pādau śirasābhivandya bhagavaṃtaṃ tṛḥpradakṣiṇīkṛtvā
children.translated_text: for alms and having completed his alms-round, returned after his meal. Having washed his feet, the <s>Bhagavān</s> sat down on the seat prepared for him, crossing his legs, holding his body upright, and establishing mindfulness before him. Then a great number of <s>bhikṣus</s> approached the <s>Bhagavān</s>; having approached, they venerated the feet of the <s>Bhagavān</s> with their heads, circumambulated him three times,
and sat down to one side.

body.translated_text: Thus have I heard. At one time, the <s>Bhagavān</s> (Blessed One) was dwelling in <s>Śrāvastī</s>, in <s>Jetavana</s>, the garden of <s>Anāthapiṇḍada</s>, together with a great assembly of <s>bhikṣus</s> (monks) — twelve hundred and fifty <s>bhikṣus</s>.

Vaj 2; folio 26v4-27v6 (Cz 27.16-28.17; P 179.14-24)
tena khalu punaḥ samayenāyuṣmān subhūtiḥ tasyām eva pariṣadi sannipatito 'bhūt sanniṣaṇṇaḥ

children.text: atha khalv āyuṣmān subhūtir utthāyāsanād ekāṃsam uttarāsaṃgaṃ kṛtvā dakṣiṇaṃ jānumaṇḍalaṃ pṛthivyāṃ pratiṣṭhāpya yena bhagavāṃs tenāṃjaliṃ praṇāmya bhagavaṃtam etad avocat / āścaryaṃ bhagavan yāvad eva tathāgatenārhatā samyaksaṃbuddhena bodhisatvā mahāsatvā anuparigṛhītāḥ parameṇānugraheṇa / yāvad eva tathāgatena bodhisatvāḥ parittāḥ paramayā parindanayā / kathaṃ bhagava
children.translated_text: Then the venerable <s>Subhūti</s> rose from his seat, arranged his upper robe over one shoulder, placed his right knee on the ground, and, joining his palms toward the <s>Bhagavān</s>, said to him: 'It is wonderful, O <s>Bhagavān</s>, how much the <s>Tathāgata</s>, the <s>Arhat</s>, the Perfectly Enlightened One, has favored the <s>bodhisattvas</s> and <s>mahāsattvas</s> with the highest favor! How much the <s>Tathāgata</s> has entrusted the <s>bodhisattvas</s> with the supreme entrustment! How, O <s>Bhagavān</s>,

children.text: bodhisatvayānasaṃprasthitena sthātavyam / kathaṃ pratipattavyam / kathaṃ cittaṃ pratigṛhītavyam / evam ukte bhagavān āyuṣmaṃtaṃ subhūtim etad av
children.translated_text: should one who has set out on the <s>bodhisattva</s> vehicle abide? How should one practice? How should one control the mind?' Thus addressed, the <s>Bhagavān</s> said to the venerable <s>Subhūti</s>

children.text: t / sādhu sādhu subhūte evam etat subhūte anuparigṛhītās tathāgatena bodhisat
children.translated_text: this: 'Well said, well said, <s>Subhūti</s>! So it is, <s>Subhūti</s> — the <s>Tathāgata</s> has favored the <s>bodhisattvas</s>

children.text: meṇānugraheṇa / parittās tathāgatena bodhisatvāḥ paramayānuparindanayā / tena hi subhūte śṛṇu sādhu ca suṣṭhu ca manasikuru bhāṣiṣye / yathā bodhisatvayānasaṃprasthitena sthātavyaṃ / yathā pratipattavyam / yathā cittaṃ pratigṛhītavyam / evaṃ bhagavann i
children.translated_text: with the highest favor; the <s>Tathāgata</s> has entrusted the <s>bodhisattvas</s> with the supreme entrustment. Therefore, <s>Subhūti</s>, listen well and attentively — I shall speak. This is how one who has set out on the <s>bodhisattva</s> vehicle should abide; this is how one should practice; this is how one should control the mind.' 'So be it, O <s>Bhagavān</s>,

body.translated_text: [Vaj 2] At that time, the venerable <s>Subhūti</s> was present in that very assembly, seated.

body.text:
Vaj 3M folio 27v6-28v1 (Cz 28.17-29.7; P 179.24-180.10)
bhagavāṃs tān etad avocat / iha subhūte bodhisatvayānasaṃprasthitair evaṃ cittam utpādayitavyam / yāvaṃtaḥ satvāḥ satvasaṃgraheṇa saṃgṛhītaḥ aṇḍajā vā jarāyujā vā saṃsvedajā vā upapādukā vā rūpiṇo vā arūpiṇo vā saṃjñino vā asaṃjñino vā naiva saṃjñino nāsaṃjñinaḥ yāvat satvadhātuḥ prajñapyamānaḥ prajñapyate te mayā sarve anupadhiśeṣe nirvāṇadhātau parini

children.translated_text: And even though immeasurable beings have been led to
has been led to <s>nirvāṇa</s>. Why is that?

children.text: sacet subhūte bodhisatvasya satvasaṃjñā pravartate na sa bodhisatva iti vaktavyaḥ
children.translated_text: If, <s>Subhūti</s>, a <s>bodhisattva</s> were to entertain the notion of a being, he should not be called a <s>bodhisattva</s>.

children.text: na sa subhūte bodhisatvo vaktavyo yasya satvasaṃjñā pravarteta jīvasaṃjñā vā pudgalasaṃjñā vā pravarteta
children.translated_text: He should not be called a <s>bodhisattva</s>, <s>Subhūti</s>, in whom the notion of a being would arise, or the notion of a living soul, or the notion of a person.

body.translated_text: [Vaj 3] The <s>Bhagavān</s> said to them: 'Here, <s>Subhūti</s>, those who have set out on the <s>bodhisattva</s> vehicle should generate this thought: as many beings as are included in the totality of beings — whether egg-born, womb-born, moisture-born, or spontaneously arisen; whether with form or without form; whether with perception, without perception, or neither with perception nor without perception — whatever realm of beings is designated, all of them I must lead to <s>nirvāṇa</s> (final liberation) in the realm of <s>nirvāṇa</s> without remainder.

body.text:
Vaj 4; folio 28v1-29r5 (Cz 29.8-30.5; P 180.10-15)
api tu khalu punaḥ subhūte bodhisatvena

children.translated_text: should give gifts without being established in

children.text: stupratiṣṭhitena dānaṃ dātavyam / na kvacitpratiṣṭhitena dānaṃ
children.translated_text: anything. He should give gifts without being established anywhere.

children.text: tavyam / na rūpapratiṣṭhitena dānaṃ dātavyam na śabdagandharasaspraṣṭavyeṣu na dharmapratiṣṭhitena dānaṃ dātavyam / evaṃ hi subhūte bodhisatvena dānaṃ dātavyam / yathā na nimittasaṃjñāyāṃ prati
children.translated_text: He should give gifts without being established in form, nor in sound, smell, taste, or tangible objects, nor established in <s>dharmas</s> (phenomena). Thus indeed, <s>Subhūti</s>, should a <s>bodhisattva</s> give gifts — in such a way that he does not become established in the perception of signs. Why is that?

children.text: yaḥ subhūte bodhisatvaḥ apratiṣṭhito dānaṃ dadāti
children.translated_text: That <s>bodhisattva</s>, <s>Subhūti</s>, who gives gifts without being established [in anything] —

children.text: te puṇyaskandhasya na sukaraṃ pramāṇam udgrahītum / tat kiṃ manyase subh
children.translated_text: heap of merit, <s>Subhūti</s>, is not easy to measure. What do you think, <s>Subhūti</s> — is it easy

children.text: syāṃ diśi ākāśasya pramāṇam udgrahītum / subhūtir āha / no hīdaṃ bhagavan / evaṃ dakṣiṇapaścimottarā
children.translated_text: the extent of space in the eastern direction?' <s>Subhūti</s> said: 'No indeed, <s>Bhagavān</s>.' 'Likewise in the southern, western, northern,

children.text: ūrdhvaṃ vidikṣu-r-avidikṣu / daśasu dikṣu / sukaram ākāśasya pramāṇam udgrahītum / subhūtir āha / na hīdaṃ bhagavan /
children.translated_text: upper directions, the intermediate and sub-intermediate directions — in the ten directions, is it easy to measure the extent of space?' <s>Subhūti</s> said: 'No indeed, <s>Bhagavān</s>.'

children.text: subhūte / evam etat subhūte yo bodhisatvo 'pratiṣṭhito dānaṃ dadāti tasya puṇyaskandhasya na sukaraṃ pramāṇam udgrahītum / api tu khalu punaḥ subhūte evaṃ bodhisatvena dānamayaṃ puṇyakṛyāvastuṃ dānaṃ dātavyam /
children.translated_text: <s>Subhūti</s>! Just so, <s>Subhūti</s>! That <s>bodhisattva</s> who gives gifts without being established [in anything] — his heap of merit is not easy to measure. Moreover, <s>Subhūti</s>, a <s>bodhisattva</s> should give gifts in just this way — [as] the meritorious action consisting of giving.'

body.translated_text: [Vaj 4] Moreover, <s>Subhūti</s>, a <s>bodhisattva</s>

body.text:
Vaj 5; folio 29r5-v4 (Cz 30.6-14)
tat kiṃ manyase subhūte tathāgato lakṣaṇasaṃpadā draṣṭavyaḥ

children.text: bhagavān āha na lakṣaṇasaṃpadā tathāgato draṣṭavyaḥ
children.translated_text: The <s>Bhagavān</s> said: 'The <s>Tathāgata</s> should not be seen by the perfection of marks.'

children.text: yā sā tathāgatena lakṣaṇasaṃpad bhāsitā saivālakṣaṇasaṃpat / evam ukte bhagavān āyuṣmaṃtaṃ subhūtim etad avocat / y
children.translated_text: 'Because that perfection of marks spoken of by the <s>Tathāgata</s> is itself the non-perfection of marks.' Thus addressed, the <s>Bhagavān</s> said to the venerable <s>Subhūti</s>: 'In

children.text: te lakṣaṇaṃ tāvan mṛṣā / yāvad alakṣaṇaṃ tāvad amṛṣā
children.translated_text: <s>Subhūti</s>, there is a mark, so far is there falsehood; in so far as there is the absence of marks, so far is there no falsehood.'
'Thus, by [the principle of] mark and non-mark, the <s>Tathāgata</s> should be seen.'

body.translated_text: [Vaj 5] 'What do you think, <s>Subhūti</s> — should the <s>Tathāgata</s> be seen by the perfection of [bodily] marks?'

body.text:
Vaj 6; folio 29v4-31v6 (Cz 30.15-32.5)
evam ukte āyuṣmān subhūti

children.text: bhagavaṃtam etad avocat / asti bhagavan kecit satvāḥ bhaviṣyaṃty anāgate 'dhvani paścimāyāṃ paṃcāśatyā
children.translated_text: said to the <s>Bhagavān</s>: 'Will there be, <s>Bhagavān</s>, any beings in the future time, in the last [period of] five hundred [years],

children.text: rūpeṣu sūtrāṃtapadeṣu bhāṣyamāṇeṣu bhūtasaṃjñām utpādayiṣyaṃti / bhagavān āha / mā tvaṃ subhūte
children.translated_text: words of the <s>sūtra</s> are being spoken, will generate a true perception of them?' The <s>Bhagavān</s> said: 'Do not speak thus, <s>Subhūti</s>!

children.text: ty anāgate 'dhvani ye imeṣv evaṃrūpeṣu sūtrāṃtapadeṣu bhāṣyamāṇeṣu bhūtasaṃjñām utpādayiṣyaṃti / api tu khalu punaḥ subhūte bhaviṣyaṃty anāgate 'dhvani bodhisatvā mahāsatvā paścimāyāṃ paṃcāśatyāṃ saddharmavipralope vartamāne śīlavaṃto guṇavaṃtaḥ prajñāva
children.translated_text: time who, when these very words of the <s>sūtra</s> are being spoken, will generate a true perception of them. Moreover, <s>Subhūti</s>, there will be in the future time <s>bodhisattvas</s> and <s>mahāsattvas</s>, in the last [period of] five hundred [years] when the decline of the true <s>Dharma</s> is underway, who will be endowed with virtue, endowed with good qualities, endowed with

children.text: to bhaviṣyaṃti / na khalu punaḥ subhūte bodhisatvā ekabuddhaparyupāsitā bhaviṣyaṃti / naikabuddhāvaropitakuśalamūlā bhaviṣyaṃti / api tu khalu punaḥ subhūte anekabuddhaparyupāsitā bhaviṣyaṃti anekabuddhāvaropitakuśalamūlā bhaviṣyaṃti / ye imeṣv eva
children.translated_text: wisdom. Nor, <s>Subhūti</s>, will those <s>bodhisattvas</s> have attended upon only one <s>Buddha</s>; nor will they have planted roots of merit under only one <s>Buddha</s>. Rather, <s>Subhūti</s>, they will have attended upon many <s>Buddhas</s> and will have planted roots of merit under many <s>Buddhas</s>. Those who, when these very

children.text: tapadeṣu bhāṣyamāṇeṣv ekacittaprasādamātram api pratilapsyaṃte / jñātās te subhūte tathāgatena dṛṣṭās te subhūte tathāgatena sarve te aprameyaṃ puṇyaskaṃdhaṃ prasaviṣyaṃti pratigṛhīṣyaṃti
children.translated_text: are being spoken, will attain even a single moment of serene faith — they are known, <s>Subhūti</s>, by the <s>Tathāgata</s>; they are seen, <s>Subhūti</s>, by the <s>Tathāgata</s>. All of them will generate and receive an immeasurable heap of merit.

children.text: subhūte bodhisatvānām ātmasaṃjñā pravartsyate na satvasaṃ
children.translated_text: <s>bodhisattvas</s>, <s>Subhūti</s>, no notion of a self will arise, no notion of a being,

children.text: na jīvasaṃjñā na pudgalasaṃjñā pravartsyate / nāpi teṣāṃ subhūte bodhisatvānāṃ dharmasaṃjñā pravartsyate nādharmasaṃjñā nāpi teṣāṃ saṃjñā nāsaṃjñā pravartsyate / tat kasya hetoḥ
children.translated_text: no notion of a living soul, no notion of a person. Nor, <s>Subhūti</s>, will a notion of <s>dharma</s> (phenomena) arise in those <s>bodhisattvas</s>, nor a notion of non-<s>dharma</s>; nor will any notion or non-notion arise in them. Why is that?

children.text: tsyate sa eva teṣām ātmagrāho bhavet / satvagrāho jī
children.translated_text: arise, that itself would be their grasping at a self, grasping at a being, grasping at a
of non-<s>dharma</s> should arise, that itself would be their

children.text: o bhavet / satvagrāho jīvagrāhaḥ pudgalagrāha iti
children.translated_text: grasping at a being, grasping at a living soul, grasping at a person.'
one should not grasp at <s>dharma</s>, nor at non-<s>dharma</s>.

children.text: sandhāya tathāgatena bhāṣitaṃ kolopamaṃ dharmaparyāyam ājānadbhiḥ dharmāḥ eva prahātavyāḥ prāg evādharmāḥ /
children.translated_text: mind, the <s>Tathāgata</s> has spoken: by those who understand the <s>Dharma</s>-teaching as like a raft, <s>dharmas</s> themselves must be abandoned — how much more so non-<s>dharmas</s>!'

body.translated_text: [Vaj 6] Thus addressed, the venerable <s>Subhūti</s>

Or has any <s>dharma</s> been taught by the <s>Tathāgata</s>?' <s>Subhūti</s> said: 'As I understand the meaning of the <s>Bhagavān</s>'s words, there is no <s>dharma</s>

That <s>dharma</s> (teaching) which was taught by the <s>Tathāgata</s>
What is the reason for that?
For the noble persons (<s>āryapudgalas</s>) are distinguished by the unconditioned (<s>asaṃskṛta</s>).

body.translated_text: [Vaj 7] Furthermore, the <s>Bhagavān</s> said to the venerable <s>Subhūti</s>: 'What

tat kiṃ manyase subhūte ya imāṃ tṛsāhasramahāsāhasr

That son of good family or daughter of good family would thereby
What is the reason for that?
That itself, O Blessed One, is a non-aggregate (<s>askandha</s>).

children.text: t tathāgato bhāṣate puṇyaskandhaḥ askandha iti bhagavān āha / yaś ca khalu punaḥ subhūte kulaputro vā kuladuhitā vā imāṃ tṛsāhasrāmahāsāhasrāṃ lokadhātuṃ saptaratnapratipūrṇaṃ kṛtvā dānaṃ dad
children.translated_text: Therefore the <s>Tathāgata</s> says: 'Merit-aggregate (<s>puṇyaskandha</s>)' — it is a non-aggregate. The Blessed One said: But moreover, <s>Subhūti</s>, if a son of good family or daughter of good family were to fill this great trichiliocosm with the seven precious things and give it as a gift,

children.text: āt / yaś ceto dharmaparyāyad aṃtaśaś catuṣpadikām api gāthām udgṛhya parebhyo deśayet saṃprakāśayed ayam eva tatonidānaṃ bahutaraṃ puṇyaṃ prasunuyāt / aprameyam asaṃkhyeyaṃ
children.translated_text: and if someone were to take up from this <s>dharmaparyāya</s> (discourse on dharma) even a single verse of four lines and teach it to others and illuminate it — this one would thereby produce far greater merit, immeasurable and incalculable.
What is the reason for that?

children.text: ato nirjātā hi subhūte tathāgatānām anuttarā samyaksaṃbodhiḥ
children.translated_text: For from this, <s>Subhūti</s>, the unsurpassed perfect awakening (<s>anuttarā samyaksaṃbodhi</s>) of the <s>Tathāgatas</s> has arisen.
And from this the <s>Buddhas</s>, the Blessed Ones,
What is the reason for that?

body.translated_text: [Vaj 8] What do you think, <s>Subhūti</s>? If someone were to fill this great trichiliocosm (billion-world system)

body.text:
Vaj 9a; folio 34rl-5 (Cz 33.26-34.11)
tat kiṃ manyase subhūte / api nu srotāpannasya evaṃ bhavati mayā srotāpattiphalaṃ prāptam iti / subhūtir āha / no hīdaṃ bhagavan

children.translated_text: The Blessed One said: What is the reason for that?

children.text: na hi sa bhagavan kiṃcid āpanna
children.translated_text: For he, O Blessed One, has not entered into anything

children.text: tenocyate srotāpanna iti / na rūpam āpanno na śabdā
children.translated_text: Therefore he is called a stream-enterer (<s>srotāpanna</s>). He has not entered into form, not into sounds,

children.text: na rasān na spraṣṭavyān na dharmān āpannaḥ
children.translated_text: not into tastes, not into tangibles, not into <s>dharmas</s> (mental objects).
Therefore he is called a stream-enterer.

body.translated_text: [Vaj 9a] What do you think, <s>Subhūti</s>? Does it occur to a stream-enterer (<s>srotāpanna</s>) thus: 'The fruit of stream-entry has been attained by me'? <s>Subhūti</s> said: No indeed, O Blessed One.

body.text:
Vaj 9b; folio 34vl-35rl (Cz 34.12-18)
bhagavān āha / tat kiṃ manyase subhūte api nu sakṛdāgāminaḥ evaṃ bhaven mayā sakṛdāgāmiphalaṃ prāptam iti / subhūtir āha / no hīdaṃ bhagavan

children.translated_text: The Blessed One said: What is the reason for that?
